items.title: AsyncRAT and Remcos Delivered in Multi-Stage Phishing Campaign
items.content:
A global phishing campaign targets business functions with emails carrying malicious Excel attachments that initiate a multi-stage infection chain when macros are enabled.
The attack uses layered obfuscation, including HTA scripts, PowerShell, encoded payloads, and steganography in PNG files, to deliver and execute Remote Access Trojans such as Remcos and AsyncRAT in a largely fileless manner.

items.title: Phishing in the Balkans: Fake Traffic Fines, Real Losses
items.content: An active SMS phishing campaign targets Serbian road users by impersonating Putevi Srbije, Serbia's state road authority. Victims receive text messages claiming they have unpaid traffic fines with urgent payment demands. The fraudulent links lead to cloned government websites designed to steal payment card details. items.title: Indirect Prompt Injection in Web Content Targets AI Agents
items.content: AI agents are increasingly vulnerable to indirect prompt injection (IPI) attacks, where malicious instructions are embedded in web content to manipulate AI-driven workflows.
